gravity

(noun). trọng lực

The apple falls because of gravity

misunderstand

(verb). hiểu sai

He had misunderstood the policeman's hand signals.

streak

(verb). Đánh dấu cái gì bằng những đường sọc, những vệt

His face was streaked with mud.

superstitious

(adjective). mê tín

I'm superstitious about the number 13.

dim

(adjective). mờ nhạt, lu mờ

The lamp gave out a dim light.

glare

(noun). ánh sáng chói lọi

This screen gives off a lot of glare.

domain

(noun). lĩnh vực

Financial matters are her domain.

triumph

(adjective). chiến trắng

The team enjoyed a triumph last night.

rotate

(verb). quay quanh trục

It takes the Earth 24 hours to rotate around itself

orbit

(noun). quỹ đạo

Today, we will learn about the orbit.

obliged

(adjective). bắt buộc

I am obliged to do my homework.

withdraw

(verb). rút lui

I have to withdraw from the competition because of the injuries.

definitive

(adjective). quyết định, cuối cùng

Finally, he had a definitive answer
